mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_job (job_uuid, owner_user_id, runner_id, gpu_count, min_memory_mib, allowed_gpu_uuids, denied_gpu_uuids, process_spec_json, status, request_key, start_command_id, stop_command_id, created_at, updated_at, execution_mode, server_id, account_id, remote_unit_name, remote_working_directory) VALUES (#{jobUuid}, #{ownerUserId}, #{runnerId}, #{gpuCount}, #{minMemoryMiB}, CAST(#{allowedGpuUuidsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{deniedGpuUuidsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{processSpecJson} AS JSON), #{status}, #{requestKey}, #{startCommandId}, #{stopCommandId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{executionMode}, #{serverId}, #{accountId}, #{remoteUnitName}, #{remoteWorkingDirectory})
mapper.select: SELECT j.* FROM train_job j JOIN train_runner_command c ON c.command_uuid = #{commandUuid} WHERE j.start_command_id = c.command_id OR j.stop_command_id = c.command_id LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM train_job WHERE execution_mode='SSH' AND ( status IN ('ALLOCATED','STARTING','RUNNING','STOPPING','RECONCILING','UNKNOWN','QUARANTINED') OR (status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','STOPPED','CANCELED') AND updated_at >= #{terminalCutoff}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','STOPPED','CANCELED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at, job_id LIMIT #{limit}
